messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 9):
"""
Policyholder shall not be required to submit the documents. 18) Claims in respect of multiple Policies held by policyholders: a) Indemnity Policies: A policyholder can file for claim settlement as per his/her choice under any policy. The Insurer of that chosen policy shall be treated as the primary Insurer. In case the available coverage under the said policy is less than the admissible claim amount, the primary Insurer shall seek the details of other available policies of the policyholder and shall coordinate with other Insurers to ensure settlement of the balance amount as per the policy conditions, without causing any hassles to the policyholder. b) Benefit based Policies: On occurrence of the insured event, the policyholders can claim from all Insurers under all policies. 19) Redressal of Grievances of the Policyholder:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I have multiple indemnity health insurance policies and my claim exceeds the coverage of the chosen policy, what will the insurer do to settle the remaining amount?","answer":"The insurer of the chosen policy will act as the primary insurer and will seek details of my other policies to coordinate with the other insurers to settle the balance amount, ensuring no hassle to me.","facts":["The Insurer of that chosen policy shall be treated as the primary Insurer","In case the available coverage under the said policy is less than the admissible claim amount, the primary Insurer shall seek the details of other available policies of the policyholder and shall coordinate with other Insurers to ensure settlement of the balance amount"]},{"question":"Can I claim from all insurers simultaneously if I have multiple benefit‑based health insurance policies and an insured event occurs?","answer":"Yes, on occurrence of the insured event, I can claim from all insurers under all benefit‑based policies.","facts":["Benefit based Policies: On occurrence of the insured event, the policyholders can claim from all Insurers under all policies"]}]}
